title: Verified Software Engineering Trajectory Record v1
description: Minimum executable contract for the verified-software-engineering-trajectories (VSET) pilot (#155 record kinds; #154 actor envelope). This slice is schema + fixtures + oracle tests only: no bulk generation, no Hub publish, no Prometheus seeding. Training views must stay compatible with #26 (no thought / internal_reasoning*). Factory onboarding of a live VSET generator is a reviewed FACTORY-REGISTRY.json row plus payload-first kind registration — not a slug hardcoded in identity logic.

training_view.description: Curated/training projection. Must not contain thought, internal_reasoning, or internal_reasoning_verbatim. Raw evidence belongs outside this object.

trace.description: Optional raw evidence. Hidden reasoning may remain here; it must not leak into training_view.
